scope.constraint: all specified public records must be recoverable at the supplied deadline
scope.controls: two independently variable real preparation coordinates; common baseline three
scope.cover: one full-history classical algebra with weight one
scope.execution: every selected word executes its full horizon, including after first publication
scope.host_work: planning, retained samples, exact decoding and random choice are supplied host interfaces
scope.optimizer: transition distribution on the complete finite move-word simplex
scope.policy: exact continuation-mass transition kernel; no failed-run rejection sampling
scope.reference: product of the specified positive move weights, normalized on all words
scope.sampling: initial receiver sample and one sample after every native mean
